use_case.name: AI-Supported Meeting Record Generation
use_case.description: Combines a meeting audio recording, the agenda document, and the participant list to produce a structured, evidence-cited meeting record capturing decisions, actions, and unresolved issues for project-manager review.

business_spec.current_process: A project coordinator listens to the meeting recording, checks the agenda and participant list, and manually prepares the meeting record. A project manager then reviews and approves the record; project team members use the approved record.
pain_points: Action tracking is inconsistent between meetings
Decisions are difficult to trace back to their source (recording or agenda)
business_spec.proposed_solution: An AI-supported pipeline that combines the meeting recording, agenda document, and participant list to draft a structured meeting record -- separating agenda topics, discussion summaries, decisions, assigned actions, unresolved issues, and conflicts -- with each decision/action/issue/conflict backed by a traceable citation, for the project manager to review and approve.
business_spec.success_criteria: Decisions and actions that are actually supported by the meeting (or, for context, the agenda) are captured accurately with evidence citations; owners, dates, approvals, or decisions that were not explicitly stated are never invented.
business_spec.poc_goal: Process a fixed input bundle (meeting WAV + agenda PDF + participant JSON, referenced by a bundle manifest) via a CLI invoked as `python run_poc.py --input <bundle_path>`. The PoC must exit successfully and save a non-empty, schema-valid JSON meeting record to poc/output/. The output must capture the frozen meeting decisions, actions, unresolved issues, and the agenda/meeting date conflict; cite audio evidence as 'file_name|start_timestamp|end_timestamp' (HH:MM:SS) and agenda evidence as 'file_name|page_number'; leave unsupported owners, dates, budget approval, and the SSO decision unset (null) with an uncertainty_reason; and set review_status to 'pending_review'. The output is compared semantically against a fixture expected_meeting_record.json. The web application, authentication, external system integrations, and operational scaling are out of scope for this first PoC.

technical_spec.security_constraints: Meeting material is internal. Access to the record must be limited to the project team and the designated reviewer (project manager). No connection to calendar, project-management, document-management, or identity systems is required or permitted in this evaluation.
technical_spec.evaluation_requirements: Compare the generated meeting_record.json semantically against fixtures/expected_meeting_record.json (decisions, actions, unresolved issues, conflicts). Validate every citation string against the required pipe-delimited pattern (file_name|start_timestamp|end_timestamp with HH:MM:SS for audio; file_name|page_number for the agenda). Confirm none of the fixture's must_not_assert statements are asserted by the output (hallucination check).
technical_spec.runtime_interface: cli: `python run_poc.py --input <bundle_path>`, where <bundle_path> is a JSON manifest referencing the meeting audio (wav), agenda (pdf), and participant list (json). The command must exit successfully and write a single JSON meeting record under poc/output/.

field_types.title: str
field_types.decisions: list[Decision] {decision_id: str, statement: str, citations: list[str]}
field_types.action_items: list[ActionItem] {action_id: str, description: str, owner: str|null, due_date: str|null, uncertainty_reason: str|null, citations: list[str]}

field_descriptions.decisions: Only statements explicitly and spoken-confirmed as decided in the meeting audio; an agenda proposal alone is not a decision.
field_descriptions.action_items: Concrete follow-up actions with owner/due_date only when explicitly stated; otherwise null + uncertainty_reason.
field_descriptions.unresolved_issues: Matters explicitly left open or pending in the meeting.
field_descriptions.conflicts: Cases where the agenda and the spoken meeting disagree; the spoken decision is authoritative and must be followed, with both sources cited.

target_output_spec.missing_value_policy: Never invent unstated facts. For action_items, set owner/due_date to null and populate uncertainty_reason when not explicitly stated. Agenda-only proposals must not be recorded as decisions unless the meeting audio confirms them; when the agenda and the meeting disagree, record a conflict entry (citing both sources) and follow the spoken decision.
target_output_spec.validation_rules: Every decision, action_item, unresolved_issue, and conflict must include at least one citation. Citations are pipe-delimited strings: 'file_name|start_timestamp|end_timestamp' (HH:MM:SS) for audio, or 'file_name|page_number' for the agenda document. review_status must equal 'pending_review' in the PoC output.

assumptions.text: Expected quantified value (e.g. hours saved per meeting) was not specified by the user.

Specific risks (e.g. misattribution, sensitive-content exposure, over-reliance on the AI record) were not specified by the user beyond the general accuracy/traceability requirement already captured in success_criteria.
The field set in fixtures/expected_meeting_record.schema.json is adopted as the final target_output_spec schema (schema_name 'MeetingRecord'); the user deferred an independent field review.
Deployment platform, authentication method, and data retention period are not yet specified.
No formatted PDF rendering of the meeting record is requested for this use case; output is JSON only.
No additional strict citation-format evaluation pass was requested beyond the schema's own citation pattern constraint and the semantic comparison against the fixture.

Business-process roles were not independently confirmed by the user; assumed project_coordinator uploads inputs, ai_system runs the pipeline, project_manager reviews/approves, no external parties, and rejection defaults to a clean discard (no rework loop).

steps.name: Provide meeting recording, agenda, and participant list
Project manager reviews and approves record

traceability.required_by: technical_spec.input_types contains audio; citations require HH:MM:SS timestamps
technical_spec.input_types contains pdf (native-text agenda); citations require file_name|page_number

MeetingRecord schema generated via GAIK SchemaGenerator; agent fixed missing fields (topics.title, unresolved_issues.description, conflicts.description) and made action_items.uncertainty_reason nullable. User approved the corrected schema.
